$comment: Template for a new firmware's patch format. Files starting with _ are ignored. Copy to <firmwareId>.json (the id from firmware/catalog.json), set id to the same name, and list only what was actually tested. Format ids become <file id>/<format key>, e.g. felucca/patch.
name: Example firmware
description: What this firmware's patches are and where the information comes from (docs link, own tests).

patch.name: Patch parameters
patch.description: Values stored under params, sent one by one at each parameter's address.
patch.$send: Transport steps, in order. Types: program-change {field, channel}, dx7-param-sysex {field}, cc-map {field, channel}, cc-list {field, channel}, params {field}, raw-sysex {field}, none {reason}. channel: note, fx or 1-16.
patch.$params: status per parameter: confirmed (tested on a device), discovered (seen in CC discovery or docs, not verified), unknown. address: {cc, channel} | {nrpn: [msb, lsb], channel} | {dx7: n} | {sysex: "F0 .. {v} .. F7"}; omit address when it can't be sent.

bank.name: Bank dump
bank.description: Kept in the Library for reference; no known way to send it yet.

send.reason: No bank transfer is known for this firmware yet.
